title: DiscoveryDocument
description: The launcher's KB discovery document — the schema authority for <stateDir>/discovery/kbs.json, which the Xynolog CLI (xynolog/cli) regenerates on every stack mutation and the Browser container mounts read-only at /discovery. NOT an API endpoint: a static document fetched same-origin by browsers (via the Browser's static server). An empty kbs list is meaningful ("the launcher manages nothing right now") and distinct from an absent file.

version.description: Document schema version. Consumers MUST check it and ignore documents they do not understand.

kbs.description: Every KB the launcher currently manages, local and forwarded
